tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background (bg-slate-950; body background in globals.css). The only ground the app paints.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables and modals (bg-slate-900), always with a border-default edge.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and module tiles sitting inside a card (bg-slate-950), recessed below surface-card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary and Cancel button fill (bg-slate-800).

tokens.name: surface-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover (hover:bg-slate-700).

tokens.name: surface-table-head
tokens.usage: Table header row tint on surface-card (bg-slate-950/50).

tokens.name: surface-row-hover
tokens.usage: Table row hover. Intentional fix: the code writes hover:bg-slate-850/50, which is not a Tailwind colour and renders nothing; this is slate-800 at 50%.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop (bg-black/70 with backdrop-blur-sm).

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Every card, input, table divider and tile edge (border-slate-800, divide-slate-800). 1px.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button edge (border-slate-700).

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, metric values, primary cell text, text on success/info/critical fills (text-white). 19.9:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default body text on surface-page and surface-card (text-slate-100; globals.css sets #f8fafc on body, pages override).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary cell values, tile labels, Cancel text (text-slate-300) on surface-card and surface-inset.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, field labels, table header labels, descriptions (text-slate-400). 6.9:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Loading and empty-state rows, placeholders (text-slate-500). Source value kept: only 3.7:1 on surface-card and 4.0:1 on surface-page, below 4.5:1 for body text; use ink-muted for anything that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent and accent-hover fills (text-slate-950). 9.1:1 on accent, 6.1:1 on accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary button fill, focus border on inputs, back-link text (amber-500).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (hover:bg-amber-600).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Amber text on dark grounds: stat-card captions, badge text, tile hover label (text-amber-400). 10:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Status badge fill and module tile hover fill (bg-amber-500/10).

tokens.name: accent-soft-border
tokens.usage: Status badge edge (border-amber-500/20).

tokens.name: accent-hover-border
tokens.usage: Module tile hover edge (hover:border-amber-500/50).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus border on inputs and selects (focus:border-amber-500; globals.css adds a 2px amber outline). 8.6:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Delete button label (text-red-400). 6.1:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Delete button fill (bg-red-500/10).

tokens.name: danger-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Delete button hover fill (hover:bg-red-500/20).

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Delete button edge (border-red-500/20).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: CRM save button fill (bg-emerald-600) under ink-strong. Source pair kept: white on it is 3.8:1, passes only as 19px+ bold.

tokens.name: success-hover
tokens.usage: Success button hover (hover:bg-emerald-500). White on it is 2.5:1 — source value, flagged.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success result title (text-emerald-400) on surface-card.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Success result panel edge (border-emerald-500/50).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Proposal issue button fill (bg-blue-600) under ink-strong, 5.2:1.

tokens.name: info-hover
tokens.usage: Info button hover (hover:bg-blue-500); also the blue focus border used on CRM, proposals, punch-list and sub-compliance forms. White on it is 3.7:1 — source value, flagged.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info result title (text-blue-400) on surface-card.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Info result panel edge (border-blue-500/50).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Punch-item log button fill (bg-rose-600) under ink-strong, 4.7:1.

tokens.name: critical-hover
tokens.usage: Critical button hover (hover:bg-rose-500). White on it is 3.6:1 — source value, flagged.

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Critical result title (text-rose-400) on surface-card.

tokens.name: critical-border
tokens.usage: Critical result panel edge (border-rose-500/50).

tokens.name: print-paper
tokens.usage: Printed proposal page (proposals/export: bg-white). Print surface only.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: Printed proposal headings and Print button fill (text-black, bg-black) on print-paper.

tokens.name: print-ink-body
tokens.usage: Printed proposal body copy (text-gray-700) on print-paper, 10.3:1.

tokens.name: print-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Printed proposal tagline (text-gray-600) on print-paper, 7.6:1.

tokens.name: print-ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Printed proposal date line (text-gray-500) on print-paper, 4.8:1.

styles.usage: Table cells, panel descriptions (text-sm). Use weight 500 for primary cells and tile labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, stat labels, table headers, back link: always UPPERCASE (text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status pills and small buttons (text-xs font-semibold).

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: JSON results and code-like inputs such as phone or PO numbers (font-mono text-xs).
